name: ColorUtils
src_typeComment: Color-math helpers that Unity's Color/Color32 API doesn't provide directly: hex string conversion, HSV hue-shifting, and generating related colors for procedural palettes (team colors, rarity tiers).

src_members.name: FromHex
src_members.comment: "#FF8800" or "FF8800" (with or without alpha, "#FF8800CC") -> Color. Returns magenta on a malformed string rather than throwing, so a bad data-entry typo shows up visually instead of crashing.

src_members.sig: public static string ToHex(Color color, bool includeAlpha = false)
src_members.name: ToHex

src_members.sig: public static Color RotateHue(Color color, float degrees)
src_members.name: RotateHue
src_members.comment: Rotates hue by degrees (0-360), preserving saturation/value — e.g. generating a set of visually distinct team colors by rotating a base hue by 360/teamCount each time.

src_members.sig: public static Color Complementary(Color color) => RotateHue(color, 180f)
src_members.name: Complementary

src_members.sig: public static (Color left, Color right) Analogous(Color color, float angleDegrees = 30f)
src_members.name: static
src_members.comment: Two colors flanking the base hue by +/- angleDegrees (30 is a common default for a pleasant, not-too-similar-not-too-clashing analogous palette).
